data/3/entries/6/entries/10/entries/3/en.english: A search of the room takes 10 minutes and turns up 38 gp, 152 sp, and 704 cp sorted into eighty-eight stacks of exactly eight copper coins each. Dozens of dragon-themed talismans and amulets are carved from bone, soapstone, wood, and ivory. The workmanship on most of them is terrible, but four have a unique, if savage, artistic flair. These are worth 50, 60, 70, and 100 gp respectively if sold to a collector of artistic oddities. To any other merchant, they are worth 10 gp each.
data/3/entries/6/entries/10/entries/3/en.zh_tw: 搜查房間需要10分鐘，可以找到38金幣、152銀幣，以及排成八十八堆、每堆正好八枚的704銅幣。此外還有數十件以骨頭、皂石、木頭及象牙雕刻的龍形符飾與護身符。大多數的工藝十分拙劣，但有四件雖然粗獷，卻展現出獨特的藝術風格。若賣給專門收藏奇異藝術品的收藏家，這四件分別價值50、60、70及100金幣；賣給其他商人則每件只值10金幣。
data/3/entries/6/entries/10/entries/3/en.reason: Remove duplicated talisman wording; preserve every treasure amount.

data/5/entries/2/entries/3.english: If characters ask around Waterdeep's northern gate about anyone matching {@creature Rezmir|HotDQ}'s description, they hear rumors of a half-dragon being sighted in the area at least a tenday ago. Everyone remembers the incident; chromatic half-dragons are almost never seen, and they tend to cause alarm when they are. If the rumor is true, then the half-dragon was traveling with a strong escort of mounted guards, headed north. The rumor is true, of course, but it can't be confirmed 100 percent.
data/5/entries/2/entries/3.zh_tw: 如果角色在深水城北門附近打聽是否有人見過符合{@creature Rezmir|HotDQ}描述的人物，會聽到傳聞：至少十天前，有人在附近見過一名半龍。所有人都記得這件事；彩色半龍幾乎從不現身，一旦出現往往就會引起恐慌。若傳聞屬實，那名半龍是在一支強大的騎兵護衛隊保護下往北行進。當然，傳聞確實屬實，只是無法百分之百證實。
data/5/entries/2/entries/3.reason: Restore at least a tenday rather than approximately a tenday.

data/6/entries/10/entries/2/entries/0.english: The ground here was once hard-packed earth, but the area in front of the barracks ({@area area 1G|14b|x}) has been churned into mud by flapping bullywug feet. At any particular time, there are {@dice 1d6}–1 {@creature Bullywug||bullywugs} and {@dice 1d6}–1 {@creature lizardfolk} present in the outer ward. Lizardfolk are likely to be working (training their giant lizards), while bullywugs might be loafing or giving orders to the lizardfolk.
data/6/entries/10/entries/2/entries/0.zh_tw: 這裡原本是夯實的泥土地，但營房（{@area 區域1G|14b|x}）前方已被啵靈蛙拍打地面的腳掌踩成泥濘。任何時刻，外院都有{@dice 1d6}–1名{@creature Bullywug||啵靈蛙}與{@dice 1d6}–1名{@creature lizardfolk}。蜥蜴人通常正在工作，訓練他們的巨蜥；啵靈蛙則可能在偷懶，或對蜥蜴人發號施令。
data/6/entries/10/entries/2/entries/0.reason: Restore bullywug/lizardfolk subjects and preserve minus-one population rolls.

data/7/entries/10/entries/2/entries/4/en.english: Refusing Talis's generous offer triggers a fight. Talis shouts for reinforcements, which brings the gargoyles from {@area area 5,|1b4|x} the helmed horror from {@area area 6|1b7|x}, and the kobolds from {@area area 12|1c9|x} running, and even yells out the window for {@creature Trepsin|HotDQ} the troll. Pull out all the stops—and if things go badly, Talis climbs out a window and flees into the woods or through a portal (see {@area area 1|1a7|x}).
data/7/entries/10/entries/2/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 拒絕塔利斯的慷慨提議就會引發戰鬥。塔利斯會大喊求援，讓{@area 區域5|1b4|x}的石像鬼、{@area 區域6|1b7|x}的恐怖鎧甲，以及{@area 區域12|1c9|x}的狗頭人全都趕來；她甚至會朝窗外呼喊巨魔{@creature Trepsin|HotDQ}。讓敵方傾巢而出。如果戰況不利，塔利斯會爬出窗戶，逃入森林或穿過傳送門（見{@area 區域1|1a7|x}）。
data/7/entries/10/entries/2/entries/4/en.reason: Remove spurious 1b4 creature count copied from an internal area ID.

data/6/entries/4/entries/1/entries/1/ent.english: During the questioning, have every character make a Charisma check. Whichever character scores highest makes a strong impression on a lizardfolk captive. This lizardfolk, whose name is Snapjaw, is unhappy about the situation in the mere, and he develops the notion that these strangers could be the key to driving out the cultists and to slaughtering their cruel bullywug allies. Snapjaw tries to communicate with the chosen character, but he doesn't want any of his comrades to know. He speaks enough pidgin Common to converse in simple terms, in case no one in the party speaks Draconic.
data/6/entries/4/entries/1/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 審問期間，讓每名角色進行一次魅力檢定。結果最高的角色會令一名蜥蜴人俘虜印象深刻。這名蜥蜴人叫咬顎，他對沼澤裡的局勢心懷不滿，開始相信這些陌生人可能是驅逐邪教徒、殺死他們殘酷的啵靈蛙盟友的關鍵。咬顎會試著與那名角色溝通，但不想讓其他同伴發現。他略懂通用語，足以簡單交談，因此即使隊伍中無人會說龍語也能溝通。
data/6/entries/4/entries/1/entries/1/ent.reason: Correct victims/allies: Snapjaw opposes bullywugs, not his own lizardfolk allies.

data/4/entries/8/entries/13/entries/1.english: The characters can join the chase, try to talk people down, protect the stag, or ignore the situation, as they see fit. It can be tracked through the forest with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check. A new check must be made every 500 yards.
data/4/entries/8/entries/13/entries/1.zh_tw: 角色可以自行決定加入追逐、試著勸阻眾人、保護雄鹿，或不理會這件事。成功通過{@dc 10}感知（{@skill Survival}）檢定，就能在森林裡追蹤牠；每前進500碼，都必須再做一次檢定。

data/6/entries/5/entries/4/entries/6/ent.english: Voaraghamanthar has a secret that is known to only two other creatures in Faerûn. One of them is {@creature Rezmir|HotDQ}. The other creature {@i is} the secret: Waervaerendor, the twin brother of Voaraghamanthar. For centuries, these twins have misled the world into believing that only one dragon dwells in the Mere of Dead Men—one dragon that must travel at immense speed, since it has been spotted at widely separated locales in rapid succession. The siblings seldom leave their lairs, but when they do, they coordinate so they are never seen together or seen in two distant places at precisely the same time.
data/6/entries/5/entries/4/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 沃拉加曼薩爾有一個秘密，在費倫只有另外兩個生物知道。其中之一是{@creature Rezmir|HotDQ}。另一個生物{@i 本身就是}那個秘密：沃拉加曼薩爾的雙胞胎兄弟沃爾維倫多爾。數個世紀以來，這對雙胞胎一直誤導世人，讓大家相信亡者沼澤只住著一條龍；由於牠曾在極短時間內出現在相距甚遠的地方，人們以為這條龍必定移動神速。兄弟倆很少離開各自的巢穴；即使外出，也會協調行動，確保彼此絕不一起露面，也不會同時在兩個遙遠的地方被人看見。
data/6/entries/5/entries/4/entries/6/ent.reason: Translate stranded italic is and restore brothers rather than brother/sister.

data/0/entries/8/entries/2/entries/2.english: If the characters played through {@i Hoard of the Dragon Queen}, they've already met one of the most influential of the Harpers: {@creature Leosin Erlanthar|HotDQ}, a male half-elf monk from Berdusk.
data/0/entries/8/entries/2/entries/2.zh_tw: 如果角色已完成{@i 龍後的寶山}，他們就見過豎琴手聯盟中最有影響力的成員之一：{@creature Leosin Erlanthar|HotDQ}，一名來自貝爾達斯克的男性半精靈武僧。
data/0/entries/8/entries/2/entries/2.reason: Restore Berdusk, misidentified as Baldur’s Gate or inconsistently transliterated.

data/1/entries/8/entries/8/entries/8/ent.english: Award standard XP for defeated foes. If characters realized they were walking into a trap, give each a 50 XP bonus. If they didn't deduce that it was a trap but spotted the ambushers in time to prevent a surprise round, give each character a 25 XP bonus.
data/1/entries/8/entries/8/entries/8/ent.zh_tw: 對於擊敗的敵人給予標準經驗值。如果角色意識到他們正步入一個陷阱，給每個人50經驗值的獎勵。如果他們沒有推斷出這是一個陷阱，但及時發現了伏擊者，避免了突襲輪，給每個角色25經驗值的獎勵。
data/1/entries/8/entries/8/entries/8/ent.reason: Distinguish rounds from turns; English contains rounds and no turns.

data/6/entries/10/entries/16/entries/2.english: If there is any disturbance in the Great Hall, everyone within hearing responds to the hue and cry. Cultists in the southwest tower and guard drakes from the inner ward show up at the start of the third round, and any bullywugs or lizardfolk in the outer ward respond at the beginning of the fourth round.
data/6/entries/10/entries/16/entries/2.zh_tw: 如果大禮堂有任何騷動，所有能聽到的人都會響應呼救聲。西南塔中的邪教徒和內院的守衛龍獸會在第三輪開始時出現，而外院的任何啵靈蛙或蜥蜴人會在第四輪開始時響應。
data/6/entries/10/entries/16/entries/2.reason: Distinguish rounds from turns; English contains rounds and no turns.

data/8/entries/7/entries/1/entries/4.english: Combat here alerts the ogres in area 6, the cultists in {@area area 9|223|x}, the stone giants in {@area area 10|224|x}, and the kobolds in {@area area 15|235|x}. One of the cultists runs to {@area area 11|229|x} and alerts {@creature Rezmir|HotDQ}, who arrives with her {@creature Guard Drake|HotDQ|guard drakes} three rounds later.
data/8/entries/7/entries/1/entries/4.zh_tw: 在此地進行戰鬥會驚動6號區域的食人魔、{@area 區域9|223|x}的邪教徒、{@area 區域10|224|x}的石巨人，以及{@area 區域15|235|x}的狗頭人。其中一名邪教徒會跑到{@area 區域11|229|x}並通知{@creature Rezmir|HotDQ|瑞茲米爾}，她帶著她的{@creature Guard Drake|HotDQ|守衛龍獸}在三個輪後到達。
data/8/entries/7/entries/1/entries/4.reason: Distinguish rounds from turns; English contains rounds and no turns.

data/8/entries/8/entries/4/entries/4/ent.english: If any ogres are taken prisoner, {@condition charmed}, or fast-talked, the characters learn relatively little. They serve the cloud giant {@creature Blagothkus|HotDQ} (whose wife was slain some years ago), they know that the cloud giant has several guests, including "duh wizard in red robes" ({@creature Rath Modar|HotDQ}), "duh dragon lady" ({@creature Rezmir|HotDQ}), and "a big white dragon dat lives in duh caves" (Glazhael). Getting more than the basic rundown takes a {@dc 19} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check for each of the following three additional items:
data/8/entries/8/entries/4/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 如果任何食人魔被俘虜、{@condition charmed||魅惑}或被花言巧語說服，角色們能瞭解到的資訊相對較少。他們為雲巨人{@creature Blagothkus|HotDQ|布拉戈提庫斯}服務（他的妻子在幾年前被殺），他們知道雲巨人有幾位客人，包括"穿紅袍的巫師"（{@creature Rath Modar|HotDQ|拉斯·莫達}）、"龍女士"（{@creature Rezmir|HotDQ|瑞茲米爾}）和"住在洞穴裡的白色巨龍"（格拉澤爾）。要獲取比基本資訊更多的內容，以下三項額外資訊，每項都需要進行一次{@dc 19}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定：
data/8/entries/8/entries/4/entries/4/ent.reason: Restore explicit count of three follow-up pieces of information.

data/0/entries/7/entries/2/entries/2/ent.english: The secret cornerstone of this union is {@creature Rath Modar|HotDQ}'s belief that once Tiamat returns, she will see that the Red Wizards are more useful allies than the devoted but magically weak cultists. {@creature Rath Modar|HotDQ} hopes that Tiamat will show her gratitude for the pivotal role he and his fellow Red Wizards played in her return, granting them an army of dragons with which to assault Thay. After unseating Szass Tam, {@creature Rath Modar|HotDQ} plans to take his place at the head of all Red Wizards. Whether Tiamat will grant such a reward—or have any further use for the Red Wizards at all—remains unknown.
data/0/entries/7/entries/2/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 這個聯盟的秘密基石是{@creature Rath Modar|HotDQ|拉斯·莫達}的信念，他認為一旦提亞馬特迴歸，她會看到紅袍法師比那些忠誠但魔法上較弱的邪教徒更有用。{@creature Rath Modar|HotDQ|拉斯·莫達}希望提亞馬特會因他和他的紅袍法師同胞在她迴歸中扮演的關鍵角色而表示感激，賜予他們一支龍的軍隊，用來攻擊賽爾。在推翻薩扎斯坦之後，{@creature Rath Modar|HotDQ|拉斯·莫達}計劃取代他成為所有紅袍法師的領袖。提亞馬特是否會給予這樣的獎賞——或者對紅袍法師是否還有進一步的利用價值——仍然是未知的。
data/0/entries/7/entries/2/entries/2/ent.reason: Resolve remaining untranslated honorific or place alias against its English context.

data/0/entries/4/entries/3/entries/0.english: At the start this adventure, representatives of groups and factions from across the Sword Coast meet to discuss their concern about the Cult of the Dragon, and to draw up plans for opposing the cult. The adventurers are summoned to Waterdeep for a summit that will come to be known as the Council of Waterdeep (see {@area chapter 9|05f|x} for details).
data/0/entries/4/entries/3/entries/0.zh_tw: 冒險開始時，劍海岸各地團體與派系的代表齊聚一堂，討論龍巫教帶來的威脅，並擬定對抗教團的計畫。冒險者受召前往深水城，出席這場後來被稱為「深水城議會」的峰會（詳見{@area 第9章|05f|x}）。
data/0/entries/4/entries/3/entries/0.reason: Remove duplicated chapter number outside its link.

data/3/entries/7/entries/3/entries/0/ent.english: This rough natural cavern holds the winch system for raising the stone slab secret door between {@area area 13|110|x} and area 14. The doorway is guarded by 6 {@creature lizardfolk}, which attack at the first sign of the door rising between this area and area 13. One lizardfolk runs to warn the yuan-ti while the others move into position near the door.
data/3/entries/7/entries/3/entries/0/ent.zh_tw: 這座粗糙的天然洞穴內裝有絞盤，用來升起{@area 區域13|110|x}與區域14之間的石板暗門。門口由6名{@creature lizardfolk}看守；只要看見本區域與區域13之間的門開始升起，他們便立即攻擊。其中一名蜥蜴人會跑去警告原體蛇人，其餘則移動到門邊就位。
data/3/entries/7/entries/3/entries/0/ent.reason: Restore second room-13 reference and remove mistranslated yuan-ti name.

data/6/entries/7/entries/9/entries/5.english: The characters can beat this challenge in several ways. The most straightforward solution is to reduce the boulder with an {@spell enlarge/reduce} spell, then use the same spell to enlarge a strong character to throw it. Other solutions might involve casting {@spell levitate} on the rock and giving it a push, digging a trench for the rock to roll down the length of the field, or propelling it with magic in some other way. The cyclopes will accept any solution the characters attempt, as long as it propels the stone farther than the cyclops did.
data/6/entries/7/entries/9/entries/5.zh_tw: 角色可以用多種方式通過這項挑戰。最直接的辦法是以{@spell enlarge/reduce}縮小巨石，再用同一法術放大一名力氣大的角色，讓其投擲巨石。其他方法包括對石頭施放{@spell levitate}再推它一把，沿場地挖出一道溝渠讓石頭滾過去，或以其他魔法手段推動石頭。只要角色設法讓石頭移動得比獨眼巨人投擲的距離更遠，獨眼巨人就會接受任何解法。
data/6/entries/7/entries/9/entries/5.reason: Replace corrupted source paragraph containing control bytes and an embedded filename.

data/6/entries/9/entries/11/entries/2.english: The creature is an {@creature efreeti} named Taraz the Fair. The name has nothing to do with his sense of justice or fair play, however, but refers to the light hues of his fiery hair. Xonthal trapped Taraz and was trying to bend or trick the efreeti into service when he disappeared. The trapped creature has had over a century of solitude to rue its fate.
data/6/entries/9/entries/11/entries/2.zh_tw: 這個生物是名為「淡焰塔拉茲」的{@creature efreeti}。他的稱號與正義感或公平競爭毫無關係，而是指他火焰般頭髮的淺淡色澤。贊薩爾將塔拉茲困在這裡，企圖以脅迫或欺騙使這名火巨靈為自己效力，卻在成功之前消失了。受困的塔拉茲已孤獨地度過一個多世紀，懊悔自己的命運。
data/6/entries/9/entries/11/entries/2.reason: Translate fair as pale coloring, not justice, as explicitly explained in English.

data/3/entries/11/entries/5/entries/2/en.english: The leader of the ettins is a female named Grunda-Gurga. She has a {@item belt of hill giant strength} but wears it improperly as a sash, receiving none of its benefits and having no awareness of its magical potential.
data/3/entries/11/entries/5/entries/2/en.zh_tw: 這些雙頭巨人的領袖是一名叫格倫達－古爾加的女性。她擁有一條{@item belt of hill giant strength}，卻錯把它當作肩帶斜披在身上，因此得不到任何好處，也不知道它具有魔法力量。
data/3/entries/11/entries/5/entries/2/en.reason: Correct ettin type and sash worn across torso versus belt around waist.

data/8/entries/6/entries/4/entries/0.english: To successfully bring {@creature Tiamat|RoT} from the Nine Hells into the world, the Red Wizards must successfully focus the summoning ritual for 10 rounds after the adventurers enter the Temple of {@creature Tiamat|RoT}. Each round, at least five Red Wizards must use an action to perform the ritual in order for it to be successfully focused for that round, helping guide {@creature Tiamat|RoT} across the planes.
data/8/entries/6/entries/4/entries/0.zh_tw: 若要成功將{@creature Tiamat|RoT}從九層地獄帶到這個世界，紅袍法師必須在冒險者進入{@creature Tiamat|RoT}神殿後，累積10輪成功維持召喚儀式的進度。每一輪，至少必須有五名紅袍法師各使用一個動作執行儀式，該輪才算成功維持儀式，藉此引導{@creature Tiamat|RoT}穿越位面。
data/8/entries/6/entries/4/entries/0.reason: Do not add consecutive requirement: next paragraph resets only after two successive failed rounds.

data/8/entries/7/entries/6/entries/4/ent.english: Once {@creature Tiamat|RoT} appears in full, she spends as many rounds as necessary to laughingly devour her hapless servants five at a time—Rath Modar, any remaining Red Wizards, then {@creature Severin|RoT} (or his corpse, as long as it is wearing the {@item Mask of the Dragon Queen|RoT}). The following round, she turns her wrath on the adventurers.
data/8/entries/7/entries/6/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: {@creature Tiamat|RoT}完全現身後，會花上所需的輪數，一邊狂笑，一邊每次吞下五名倒楣的僕從：先是拉斯·莫達與任何倖存的紅袍法師，接著是{@creature Severin|RoT}，或他仍戴著{@item Mask of the Dragon Queen|RoT}的屍體。下一輪，她便會將怒火轉向冒險者。
data/8/entries/7/entries/6/entries/4/ent.reason: Restore five servants at a time, omitted in the initial translation; distinguish rounds from turns.

data/6/entries/7/entries/13/entries/5.english: The gorgon won't follow the characters out of the maze. If the gorgon is killed, another gorgon materializes somewhere in the {@area area 1|19c|x} minute later.
data/6/entries/7/entries/13/entries/5.zh_tw: 石化鐵牛不會跟隨角色離開迷宮。如果牠被殺死，另一隻石化鐵牛會在{@area 1|19c|x}分鐘後，於迷宮的某處出現。
data/6/entries/7/entries/13/entries/5.reason: Upstream erroneously wraps area 1 in the time expression; retain lookup target and restore legible timing. See source-issues report.

data/0/entries/8/entries/2/entries/2.english: If the characters played through {@i Hoard of the Dragon Queen}, they've already met one of the most influential of the Harpers: Leosin Erlanthar, a male half-elf monk from Berdusk.
data/0/entries/8/entries/2/entries/2.zh_tw: 如果角色已完成{@i 龍後的寶山}，他們就見過豎琴手聯盟中最有影響力的成員之一：雷歐辛·厄蘭塔，一名來自貝爾達斯克的男性半精靈武僧。
data/0/entries/8/entries/2/entries/2.reason: Restore Berdusk, misidentified as Baldur’s Gate or inconsistently transliterated.

data/3/entries/6/entries/5/entries/6/ent.english: If the adventurers spoke well to the statues in area 1, the voice says, "Yuan-ti have taken the one called {@creature Varram|RoT} beyond their portal in the northern wall. Be prepared, for I shall open the way to peril." Unless the characters ask {@creature Diderius|RoT} to wait, a moment later, with a chiming sound, the secret door opens to {@area area 14|11d|x}. The party gains a surprise round to act against the guards there.
data/3/entries/6/entries/5/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 如果冒險者們對區域1中的雕像說話得當，聲音會說："蛇人已將名為{@creature Varram|RoT|瓦拉姆}的生物帶過北牆上的傳送門。做好準備，我將開啟通向危險之路。"除非角色要求{@creature Diderius|RoT|迪德里烏斯}等待，片刻之後伴隨著鈴聲，密門將通向{@area 區域14|11d|x}。小隊可獲得一輪突襲輪來對付那裡的守衛。
data/3/entries/6/entries/5/entries/6/ent.reason: Distinguish rounds from turns; English contains rounds and no turns.

data/3/entries/11/entries/5/entries/1/en.english: Any fight here draws the creatures in areas 3, 4, and {@area 5|148|x}, which fight as described below. Chuth emerges from the pool and joins the fight 3 rounds later.
data/3/entries/11/entries/5/entries/1/en.zh_tw: 在這裡的任何戰鬥都會吸引3號、4號區域以及{@area 5|148|x}的生物，它們會如下文所述參與戰鬥。楚斯從池塘中出現，並在3輪後加入戰鬥。
data/3/entries/11/entries/5/entries/1/en.reason: Distinguish rounds from turns; English contains rounds and no turns.

data/4/entries/7/entries/3/entries/2/ent.english: An attack in a marketplace, garden, or some other outdoor location opens with the black dragon and one or more flying nycaloths appearing overhead to create a panic. The cultists are hanging on to the dragon, but they drop down to engage the party in melee while the dragon circles above, attacking with its breath weapon and using its Frightful Presence on rounds when its breath is still recharging. While the crowd inhibits the characters' movement, mezzoloths can easily and rapidly teleport through it.
data/4/entries/7/entries/3/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 在市場、花園或其它戶外地點的襲擊以黑龍和一隻或多隻飛行的征伐羅斯魔出現在頭頂開始，以製造恐慌。教團成員掛在龍身上，但他們下降與隊伍進行近戰，而龍在上方盤旋，使用其吐息武器，並在其吐息武器仍在重新充能的輪中使用其駭人威儀效果。當人群限制了角色們的移動時，毒蟲羅斯魔可以輕鬆快速地透過人群進行傳送。
data/4/entries/7/entries/3/entries/2/ent.reason: Distinguish rounds from turns; English contains rounds and no turns.

data/6/entries/7/entries/5/entries/0.english: Because the maze doesn't exist in normal space, it cannot be traditionally mapped. Instead, it is shown here as a set of seven nodes where encounters occur. Moving between two nodes takes {@dice 2d6} rounds regardless of whether characters walk or run. Characters experience such movement as if walking down a well-groomed path in a hedge garden. The path curves so that characters can't see more than 15 feet ahead, exactly as if they were in a circular garden with concentric paths. Cutting through hedges has no effect on how long it takes characters to get from one node to the next. Characters who return to look for a spot previously cut through will never find it.
data/6/entries/7/entries/5/entries/0.zh_tw: 由於迷宮不存在於普通空間，因此不能傳統地進行地圖繪製。相反，這裡將其展示為七個節點的集合，其中發生遭遇。無論角色是步行還是奔跑，兩個節點之間的移動都需要{@dice 2d6}輪。角色體驗這種移動就像在修剪整齊的樹籬花園中沿著一條小路行走。小路彎曲得使角色看不到前方超過15尺的地方，就像他們處在一個有同心路徑的圓形花園中一樣。穿過樹籬對角色從一個節點到下一個節點所需的時間有影響。返回尋找之前穿過的地方的角色永遠不會找到它。
data/6/entries/7/entries/5/entries/0.reason: Distinguish rounds from turns; English contains rounds and no turns.

data/6/entries/7/entries/7/entries/4.english: If the characters take the correct path, they return to area 1 after {@dice 2d6} rounds. Each time they return, the sundial points toward a different path, in the order presented below. However, each time the characters enter this area after the first, the gnomon casts more than one shadow. The adventurers must deduce the correct path from among multiple shadows, but those solutions aren't obvious or even fair. Xonthal was trying to keep enemies and curiosity-seekers out—not just to present them with an enjoyable mental challenge.
data/6/entries/7/entries/7/entries/4.zh_tw: 如果角色選擇了正確的路徑，他們在{@dice 2d6}輪後返回到區域1。每次他們返回時，日晷都會指向不同的路徑，按照下面呈現的順序。然而，每次角色在第一次之後進入這個區域，日晷會投射出多個影子。冒險者們必須從多個影子中推斷出正確的路徑，但這些解決方案並不明顯，甚至不公平。贊薩爾試圖阻止敵人和好奇者進入——不僅僅是為了給他們提供一個愉快的智力挑戰。
data/6/entries/7/entries/7/entries/4.reason: Distinguish rounds from turns; English contains rounds and no turns.

data/6/entries/9/entries/6/entries/3.english: A creature knocked off the walkway appears to fall into infinite space. Unless the creature can fly or teleport back to the walkway, it quickly vanishes from sight. Roll {@dice 1d4 + 17}; the number rolled is the number of the room where the character materializes and crashes to the floor on the following round, taking 14 ({@dice 4d6}) bludgeoning damage from the fall.
data/6/entries/9/entries/6/entries/3.zh_tw: 一隻被擊落走道的生物看起來像是掉入了無限空間。除非生物能夠飛行或傳送回走道，否則它很快就會從視線中消失。擲一個{@dice 1d4 + 17}；擲出的數字是角色在下一輪出現在的房間編號，並且從高處墜落到地面上，受到14點（{@dice 4d6}）鈍擊傷害。
data/6/entries/9/entries/6/entries/3.reason: Distinguish rounds from turns; English contains rounds and no turns.

data/8/entries/7/entries/6/entries/2.english: During the battle in the temple, read the following text aloud after 10 rounds of the summoning ritual have been successfully focused by five or more Red Wizards.
data/8/entries/7/entries/6/entries/2.zh_tw: 在神廟中的戰鬥中，在五個或更多的紅袍法師成功集中進行召喚儀式的10輪後，請大聲朗讀以下文字。
data/8/entries/7/entries/6/entries/2.reason: Distinguish rounds from turns; English contains rounds and no turns.

data/8/entries/7/entries/6/entries/4/ent.english: {@creature Tiamat|RoT}'s heads enter the battle starting on the second round after the ritual is completed, in the following order: white, black, green, blue, and red. Her red head announces the Dragon Queen's full appearance in the sixth round after the ritual is completed. Until that round, {@creature Tiamat|RoT} can make use only of her bite attacks and breath weapons. This gives the characters a last chance to try to weaken the Dragon Queen before she appears.
data/8/entries/7/entries/6/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: {@creature Tiamat|RoT|提亞馬特}的頭部在儀式完成後的第二輪開始進入戰鬥，順序如下：白色、黑色、綠色、藍色和紅色。她的紅色頭部在儀式完成後的第六輪宣佈龍後的完整降臨。在那之前，{@creature Tiamat|RoT|提亞馬特}只能使用她的咬擊和吐息武器。這給了角色們在龍後出現前最後一次嘗試削弱龍後的機會。
data/8/entries/7/entries/6/entries/4/ent.reason: Distinguish rounds from turns; English contains rounds and no turns.

data/3/entries/6/entries/5/entries/6/ent.english: {@creature Diderius|RoT} can use mummy lord legendary actions, but he is unusual because he casts wizard spells. He uses his 18 Intelligence as his spellcasting ability (his Wisdom remains 18) and has the following wizard spells prepared:

data/3/entries/6/entries/5/entries/6/ent.reason: Restore Intelligence 18 as casting ability; Wisdom also remains 18.

data/3/entries/6/entries/5/entries/0/ent.english: If the characters spoke properly to the statues in {@area area 1|0f1|x}, an unfamiliar voice is heard to whisper as they enter this area: "Humility proffered in the manner of Mystril shelters those opening the way to seeking knowledge." A successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check reminds a character of a holy gesture among adherents of the fallen goddess Mystril, involving turning the head downward and raising the hands as if holding a lamp. Characters who make this gesture while opening the double doors to the north can pass without difficulty.
data/3/entries/6/entries/5/entries/0/ent.zh_tw: 如果角色在{@area 區域1|0f1|x}對雕像以禮相待，進入本區域時會聽到陌生的低語：「依蜜絲瑞爾的教儀謙卑致敬，便能庇護開啟求知之路的人。」成功通過{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Religion}）檢定的角色，會想起已殞落的女神蜜絲瑞爾（Mystril）信徒所用的神聖手勢：低下頭，雙手高舉，彷彿托著一盞燈。角色開啟北方雙扇門時若做出這個手勢，便能順利通過。
data/3/entries/6/entries/5/entries/0/ent.reason: Preserve source deity Mystril separately from Mystra; retain English name for identification.

data/0/entries/8/entries/3/entries/5/ent.english: Ontharr Frume's dedication to heroic justice creates a strong connection between him and the paladin Sir Isteval. However, Ontharr has difficulty reconciling the heroic Isteval of legend with the diplomatic and retiring figure of the Council of Waterdeep. It's incomprehensible to him why Sir Isteval does not take to the field himself in this great conflict.
data/0/entries/8/entries/3/entries/5/ent.zh_tw: 昂塔爾·弗魯姆對英雄正義的奉獻使他與聖武士伊斯提瓦爾爵士之間建立了牢固的聯絡。然而，昂塔爾很難將傳說中的英雄伊斯提瓦爾與深水城議會中外交和隱退的形象相協調。他無法理解為什麼伊斯提瓦爾爵士在這場重大沖突中不親自上戰場。
data/0/entries/8/entries/3/entries/5/ent.reason: Resolve remaining untranslated honorific or place alias against its English context.

data/0/entries/8/entries/5/entries/11/en.english: Sir Isteval has much in common with Ontharr Frume of the Order of the Gauntlet. The two are potential allies in all things, which worries some of the other Lords' Alliance members.
data/0/entries/8/entries/5/entries/11/en.zh_tw: 伊斯提瓦爾爵士與盾牌秩序的昂塔爾·弗魯姆有許多共同之處。兩者在所有事情上都是潛在的盟友，這讓其他一些領主聯盟的成員感到擔憂。
data/0/entries/8/entries/5/entries/11/en.reason: Resolve remaining untranslated honorific or place alias against its English context.

data/1/entries/5/entries/7/entries/2/ent.english: Bartering away portions of the hoard that the cult stole is the only way some factions can make concessions. For every concession that was made for a share, circle a negative (−) icon in the following order: Dagult Neverember, Connerad, Melandrach, Lady Laeral, Ulder Ravengard, Taern Hornblade, the Harpers, Sir Isteval, and the Order of the Gauntlet. The Emerald Enclave is not affected by such concessions, since the order has not been overly affected by the dragon raids.
data/1/entries/5/entries/7/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 透過交換邪教所盜寶庫的一部分是一些派系能夠做出讓步的唯一方式。對於為份額所做出的每一個讓步，按照以下順序圈出一個負號(−)圖示：達格魯特·奈弗伯，康納拉德，梅蘭德拉克，萊拉女士，烏爾德·瑞文嘉德，塔恩·霍恩布萊德，豎琴手，伊斯提瓦爾爵士，以及盾牌秩序。翠綠閒庭不受此類讓步的影響，因為該秩序並未受到龍類襲擊的嚴重影響。
data/1/entries/5/entries/7/entries/2/ent.reason: Resolve remaining untranslated honorific or place alias against its English context.

data/3/entries/5/entries/0.english: {@creature Varram|RoT} the White is a close ally and confidant of {@creature Severin|RoT}, but the Cult of the Dragon leader is unaware of how his old friend's actions have threatened the cult's plans. {@creature Varram|RoT}'s {@item White Dragon Mask|RoTOS} has gone missing, stolen by a thief allied with the Zhentarim and now hidden from normal scrying magic. {@creature Varram|RoT} is desperate to retrieve the mask before {@creature Severin|RoT} discovers it is missing, and so he has created the pretense of taking a group of trusted followers to seek out a site of ancient magic in the Serpent Hills, which he claims will help the cult in its plans to summon {@creature Tiamat|RoT}. In truth, {@creature Varram|RoT} is seeking the Tomb of {@creature Diderius|RoT}—site of an ancient divination pool that he hopes will show him the location of the lost mask.
data/3/entries/5/entries/0.zh_tw: 白龍語者{@creature Varram|RoT|瓦拉姆} 是 {@creature Severin|RoT|賽維林} 的親密盟友和心腹，但龍巫教的領袖並不知道他的這位老朋友的行為已經威脅到了教團的計劃。{@creature Varram|RoT|瓦拉姆} 的 {@item White Dragon Mask|RoTOS|白龍面具} 已經丟失，被一個與 散塔林會 有聯盟的盜賊偷走，並且現在對常規的占卜魔法隱藏了起來。{@creature Varram|RoT|瓦拉姆} 迫切想要在 {@creature Severin|RoT|賽維林} 發現面具丟失之前取回它，所以他製造了一個藉口，帶著一群值得信賴的追隨者去尋找位於蛇丘的古代魔法遺址，他聲稱這將幫助教團在召喚 {@creature Tiamat|RoT|提亞馬特} 的計劃中。實際上，{@creature Varram|RoT|瓦拉姆} 正在尋找 {@creature Diderius|RoT|迪德里烏斯} 的墓穴——一個古老的占卜池所在地，他希望這能顯示他丟失面具的位置。
data/3/entries/5/entries/0.reason: Resolve remaining untranslated honorific or place alias against its English context.
